look_here_first: Texas-native perennial tridens with a compact to narrow seedhead and a distinctly southwestern dry-grassland look.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local source; Kew accepts Tridens texanus as native in Texas and northeastern Mexico.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; exact target-zone county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Poaceae: use growth habit, ligule, panicle architecture, spikelet form, lemma hairs and awns. For this old Tridens complex, panicle openness/color and current genus placement are especially useful.
best_field_traits: less tall and purple than T. flavus
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Think compact Texas species rather than tall purpletop. It remains in Tridens in current Kew treatment, unlike Buckley's and slim tridens.

learner_visual_status.note: Temporary one-photo learner coverage. Keep until stronger diagnostic gallery coverage replaces or supplements it.
